_comment: In-browser language models (WebLLM, systems/llm/webllmProvider.js). Ids are WebLLM prebuiltAppConfig model_ids for @mlc-ai/web-llm 0.2.86; download = the one-time download, vram = the GPU memory it needs while loaded.

models.label: Llama 3.2 3B (best writing)
models.note: About 1.8 GB download; needs about 2.3 GB of graphics memory. The default: the best prose of the three.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 1.5B (fast)
models.note: About 0.9 GB download; needs about 1.6 GB of graphics memory. Quicker replies, plainer lines.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 0.5B (tiny, weak GPUs)
models.note: About 0.3 GB download; needs under 1 GB of graphics memory. For integrated graphics: fast but simple-minded.
